svg.title: פרופיל חיכוך מעטפת ממוצע בין מפלסי המדידה (kPa)
svg.desc: Average shaft friction is constant only within each measured inter-gauge interval. Depth increases downward. No line is extended to the unmeasured pile head or toe, or across the O-cell gap. Circles identify interval averages; hollow circles flag intervals for review. Dashed lines show unloading. Negative values remain visible.
